svg.text: Axle machining layout: complete nominal station schedule
CW2-A01 · CW2-R0 · 20 October 2026 · millimetres · QUOTE / DESIGN REVIEW
Axle 1 plain / axle 2 with brake keyway · common axis datum A · midplane Y=0
Diameters exaggerated for clarity; use the station schedule.
1330 overall
810 body Ø100
Symmetric stations (absolute Y from midplane)
405–550: Ø110 wheel seat, length 145 [F01/D01]
550–600: Ø104 shoulder / possible seal land, length 50 [D02/S01]
600–640: Ø90 bearing journal, length 40 [F02]
640–643: Ø86 ×3 relief ENVELOPE ONLY [D03]
643–665: M90×2 thread envelope, length 22 [D04]
Location and inspection datums
A: common journal axis (proposed)
B: right locating shoulder face Y600
Both shoulder faces perpendicular to A
Seat/journal coaxiality and runout: HOLD
Centre-hole form and size: shop to specify
No welding or wheel-key slot specified
Wheel hubs occupy |Y|410–550 (140); seats extend 5 further inboard. Final effective contact and press location need F01/P02.
Fillets / lead-ins at Y±405,±550,±600 and relief ends are not sharp-corner machining instructions: see CW2-A02.
Material, heat treatment, NDT, roughness and all tolerances must accompany supplier approval. Nominal sizes cannot select fits.
Axle 2 retains one brake keyway on +X flank at Y290–390. Axle 1 has no brake keyway in the current one-brake-per-bogie study.
HOLD codes require supplier / engineer return. No general tolerance applies. NOT FOR MACHINING.
Solid dimensions = inherited nominal CAD or catalog interfaces. Amber dashed features = unresolved definition.
